title: What to do as a family in December | Family Season
description: Three ready plans for December for the whole family: the flat made cosy, winter fun in the yard, and a month of presents for others as well as our own. Open one, change it, print it on A4.
label: December
heading: What to do as a family in December
lead: December goes by faster than any other month: between work, presents and the tree it is over before the family notices it happened.

So it is worth writing down in advance — otherwise all that is left is the rush and the last night of the year. The three plans below are three different Decembers: the house, the street and the presents.
seasonsText: Each one opens in full: the weeks, a project for everybody in the family, the goal of the month. Any of them can be rewritten for you and printed on two A4 sheets.
actionText: If none of them fits, build your own: the theme of the month, four weeks and a project each. It prints the same way — two pages, and onto the fridge.
moreText: Other families put their seasons up too — there are more on the showcase.
